title: Agent4cs：面向大型分层代码库的多智能体代码摘要系统
summary: Agent4cs是一个多智能体框架，通过自底向上的方式对大型代码库进行摘要。它包含三个智能体：摘要生成、关键词提取和质量保证，分别负责生成摘要、识别关键信息和迭代优化输出。在7个前沿模型上评估，语义一致性平均提升8%，关键词覆盖率提升高达38%。
summary_en: Agent4cs is a multi-agent framework for summarizing large codebases in a bottom-up manner. It consists of three agents: summarization, keyword extraction, and quality assurance. Evaluated on 7 frontier models, it achieves an average 8% improvement in semantic consistency and up to 38% gain in keyword coverage.
